prompts.app: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: single finished square mobile app icon master for Union of Kingdoms. The attached comparison sheet is the reference. Reproduce ONLY the chosen A · KINGDOM emblem in the left column, preserving its identity: a squat ivory three-tower castle with a tall central royal-blue conical roof, two smaller royal-blue conical side roofs, two tiny blue flags, a large simple brown arched wooden gate, one small dark window on each tower, two compact sage-green bushes at the base, and a large three-point golden crown centered above and touching the main roof. Preserve the chunky friendly proportions, warm ivory walls, dark espresso-brown outlines, royal-blue roofs, restrained golden crown and broad cel-shading of the selected A design. Refine edges for a polished original game brand symbol. Very simple flat hand-drawn 2D fantasy art, soft oversized silhouettes and two broad light values, no photographic texture or realistic metal. Scene/backdrop: flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF full-bleed square background, no rounded corners, no outside tile, no UI frame, no drop shadow cast by a tile, no comparison sheet, no text. Composition: one complete emblem centered optically, all crown tips, flags and bushes fully visible. Whole castle-and-crown emblem fills about 74 percent of the square height and 72 percent of the width, with clean balanced white space around it. Do not change the castle into a different design, no extra tower, no tiny brick patterns, no new ornamental detail, no scenery, no ground slab, no weapons, no characters, no letters, no watermark. Output one large high-quality square final icon image, not a mockup, preserving A · KINGDOM.
prompts.favicon: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: final simplified favicon master matching the user-approved A · KINGDOM design for Union of Kingdoms. The input image is the reference comparison board. Reproduce ONLY the tiny Favicon motif under A · KINGDOM in the LEFT column, enlarging it into one clean high-resolution square symbol. Keep the same recognizable simplified design: ONE squat warm-ivory tower, ONE royal-blue triangular conical roof, ONE broad dark espresso arched gate, ONE warm-gold three-point rounded crown centered above and touching the tip of the blue roof. Flat simple hand-drawn 2D fantasy symbol with thick dark espresso outline. Extremely sparse geometry and broad colour masses, designed to remain clear at 16x16 and 32x32 pixels. Crown tips are broad and rounded, line thickness balanced across all parts. Very restrained two-tone shading only, no extra window, no side towers, no flags, no bushes, no detailed door planks, no gradients with tiny features. Entire tower and crown complete and centered, fill roughly 84 percent of square height with balanced free margin, no clipping. TRUE TRANSPARENT background and transparent negative space around the emblem, alpha channel preserved. Remove the white app tile from the reference; no background square, no checkerboard drawn into artwork, no UI frame, no rounded corners, no shadow, no presentation board, no text, no letters, no watermark. Output exactly one single finished favicon illustration with transparent background, matching A · KINGDOM.

preparation: App: generated square scaled to 820px centered on 1024px white canvas. Favicon: alpha bounds fitted within 924px on transparent 1024px canvas. Maskable: 84% inset of the padded app master on white.
